title: Watercolour Level 1 (55+)
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 16 – November 25, 2025 [SKIP September 30] Tuesdays | 1:00 – 3:30 pm | Age 55+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio 50 Victoria Street, Aurora This watercolour class will be of interest to participants who have some basic watercolour experience. Participants will learn more about mixing colours, watercolour techniques such as washes and dry brushing, and how to plan a watercolour project from start to finish with the help of demos from the instructor. Participants can use graphite paper to trace the project or they can choose to draw the project. Courses tailored for adults 55+ encourage discovery, creativity and social connection in an environment that supports effective learning strategies for mature learners.
